description: This file defines the {@link PurgeEntitiesReason} class, which represents a specific reason for shutting down or purging entities within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods to instantiate the reason from a list of entity IDs, serialize/deserialize to/from JSON, and check relevance for a given value.

classes.name: PurgeEntitiesReason
classes.description: An immutable class representing a reason to purge specific entities, identified by their entity IDs, in the context of a shutdown or clear command within Eclipse Ditto.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of PurgeEntitiesReason from a list of EntityId objects, converting them to Strings and ensuring the list is not empty.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a PurgeEntitiesReason from a given JsonObject, extracting the list of entity IDs to purge.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of shutdown reason, which is PURGE_ENTITIES.

methods.name: isRelevantFor
methods.description: Checks whether a given object (typically a CharSequence) matches any of the entity IDs scheduled for purging.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this reason to a JSON object, using a default schema and predicate.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this reason to a JSON object with specified schema version and predicate.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides equals to compare entity IDs lists.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides hashCode based on entity IDs.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the PurgeEntitiesReason instance.
